name: common-room
description: Turn Common Room into your GTM copilot. Research accounts and contacts, prep for calls and log what came out of them, and draft personalized outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone. Build and qualify prospect lists, enroll contacts in sequences, load call lists and watch your accounts and champions for changes, report on team activity and tie it to pipeline, generate weekly briefings, and create strategic account plans — all grounded in real signal data from product usage, engagement and intent signals, so every output reflects what's actually happening in your accounts. Outreach and CRM actions run only after a workspace admin allows them, and Claude asks before each one.
